images.title: Three big ideas about proportion
images.purpose: Summarises the chapter in three cards: a ratio a : b, a proportion with ad = bc, and sharing in the ratio m : n.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three equal cards in one row with wide gaps between them, one small diagram and one short formula on each.
images.exact_structure: Exactly three equal white cards with thin dark outlines, in one row. Card 1: one small rectangle whose bottom edge is thick teal (#0072B2) and left edge thick amber (#E69F00), with a : b under it, a in teal and b in amber. Card 2: a : b :: c : d with a teal arc joining a and d above and an amber arc joining b and c below, and ad = bc under it. Card 3: one bar split into exactly 5 equal boxes, 3 teal and 2 amber, with m : n above it and m + n groups under it. The reddish purple (#CC79A7) accent is used only as a thin top stripe on each card. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A ratio compares in order, proportional ratios have ad = bc, and sharing in m : n uses m + n groups.
